user.title: Local Track
user.description: Pick the people or trackers whose positions should be kept for years. Every position is stored in a separate database that the recorder never purges.

error.no_entities: Pick at least one person or device tracker.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Local Track is already set up. Use Configure to change it.

init.title: Local Track
init.description: A position is stored when it is at least the given distance away from the last one, or when the given time has passed. Points older than the downsampling age are thinned out to one per interval.

error.no_entities: Pick at least one person or device tracker.

import_history.name: Import history
import_history.description: Backfills the store from Home Assistant's recorder. It can only reach as far back as the recorder still keeps data — usually a few days, set by purge_keep_days. A day that already holds points is skipped unless Overwrite is on.

entity_id.name: Entities
entity_id.description: Which recorded entities to import. Empty means all entities this entry records.

days.name: Days back
days.description: How far back to ask the recorder. Anything the recorder has already purged cannot be recovered.

overwrite.name: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Delete a day's stored points before importing it again. Off means such a day is left untouched.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Count only, write nothing. Use it to see how much would arrive before it does.
